milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The andesite wall is at spawn-relative (-2, 0-3, -1 to 0), only ~2 blocks from spawn on the left wall. Target is the center of the andesite cluster at (-2, 1, 0). Max_distance=5 ensures the player is actually near the andesite (prevents false triggers from across the 14-block corridor). Facing_tolerance=60° confirms the player is looking toward it, modeling 'finding' the block visually.

Uses inventory_has because this is a mine task and the mined drop ends up in inventory. CRITICAL MINECRAFT MECHANIC: Block of Lapis Lazuli (lapis_block) drops ITSELF when mined with any pickaxe — it does NOT drop lapis_lazuli items (that's lapis_ore behavior only). The player has an iron pickaxe provided at spawn. There are 3 lapis blocks at (5,0,4), (5,1,4), and (6,0,4). Mining at least one puts lapis_block in inventory.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The magenta glazed terracotta is at spawn-relative (10, 0-1, 6) at the far end of the corridor (~12 blocks from spawn). Target is (10, 1, 6) at eye level. Max_distance=8 ensures the player has actually walked toward the far end of the cave rather than triggering from near spawn. Facing_tolerance=60° confirms the player is looking at the distinctive magenta block with its arrow/chevron pattern.
